```{=html}
<figure class="shear-figure" data-shear-lab>
  <figcaption class="figure-heading">
    <span class="figure-title">A horizontal shear</span>
    <span class="figure-formula" aria-label="x goes to x plus k times y, and y stays fixed">S<sub>k</sub>(x, y) = (x + ky, y)</span>
  </figcaption>
  <div class="shear-stage">
    <img class="shear-fallback" src="assets/figures/shear.png" width="960" height="476" alt="The dashed unit circle and its tilted elliptical image under a horizontal shear of one. Both enclose the same area.">
    <canvas class="shear-canvas" hidden role="img" aria-label="The unit circle and its image under a horizontal shear."></canvas>
  </div>
  <div class="figure-key" aria-hidden="true">
    <span><i class="key-line before"></i>Unit circle</span>
    <span><i class="key-line after"></i>Sheared circle</span>
  </div>
  <noscript><p class="static-shear-caption">The figure shows the shear at <i>k</i> = 1.</p></noscript>
  <div class="shear-controls" hidden>
    <label for="shear-value">Shear <i>k</i></label>
    <input id="shear-value" type="range" min="-1.5" max="1.5" step="0.05" value="1" aria-describedby="shear-hint">
    <output for="shear-value" aria-hidden="true">1.00</output>
  </div>
  <span id="shear-hint" class="visually-hidden">Use the arrow keys to adjust the shear. The marked point is the image of (0, 1).</span>
</figure>
<script src="assets/shear.js" defer></script>
```
